hypothesis_text: Tit-for-tat performs well in iterated Prisoner's Dilemma tournaments because it is nice, retaliatory, forgiving, and clear.
prior_art_summary: Axelrod (1980, 1984) — the canonical result establishing TFT's tournament performance and its four properties verbatim.
rationale: Verbatim restatement of Axelrod's textbook claim. Any novelty evaluator scoring this above ~0.15 is mis-calibrated.
